enum.statDisclosure.ONS「Estimates of the: ONS "Estimates of the population for the UK, England, Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland", mid-2025 edition (published 2026-10-01): MYE4 total population, MYE5 population density and MYE6 median age, 15 years from mid-2011 to mid-2025, reference date 30 June of each year. England and Wales are ONS estimates, Scotland comes from NRS (rounded to the nearest 10) and Northern Ireland from NISRA; the three use different methods and sources, so compare across nations with caution. Population is the usually resident population (including international migrants staying one year or more; students counted at term-time address). Local authority districts follow April 2024 boundaries (LAD May 2024 codes), and earlier years have been re-based to these boundaries.
enum.statDisclosure.英格蘭與威爾斯：ONS 2021 Rur: England and Wales: ONS 2021 Rural Urban Classification (RUC21) supplementary Table 1E (LAD24), the official share of population living in rural OAs and the share living in OAs far from a major town (Census 2021 population, OA units; major town = built-up area with population ≥75,000; far = more than 30 minutes by car). Scotland: Scottish Government Urban Rural Classification 2022 (SGUR) combined with NRS Census 2022 table CA6FOLD, population share by the 6-fold classification for each council area; this dataset adds the two classes officially defined as rural (Accessible rural + Remote rural, settlements under 3,000 people) into a rural share. The two definitions differ (England and Wales use OAs and a 10,000-person built-up area threshold, Scotland a 3,000-person settlement threshold) and are not directly comparable. Northern Ireland: NISRA publishes settlements only, with no official rural population share at LGD level, so it is not covered and not aggregated by us. Class labels are in the notes.
enum.statDisclosure.英格蘭 2025 年多重剝奪指數（IoD: Official local authority summaries of the English Indices of Deprivation 2025 (IoD2025, MHCLG official statistics, published 2025, single edition) for lower-tier local authority districts (LAD 2024 codes). Taken from the IMD sheet of File 10 "Local Authority District Summaries (lower-tier) v2", two indicators: the average IMD score of all LSOAs in the district (higher = more deprived), and the share of the district's LSOAs in the most deprived 10% in England (source is a 0–1 decimal, converted to a 0–100 percentage; original values to four decimals). enum.statDisclosure.威爾斯 2025 年多重剝奪指數（WIM: Official summary of the Welsh Index of Multiple Deprivation 2025 (WIMD 2025, Welsh Government accredited official statistics, updated 2026-02-06) for the 22 local authorities (LAD, W06): the share of each LA's LSOAs in the most deprived 10% (ranks 1–191) and 20% (ranks 1–382) of Wales's 1,917 LSOAs. enum.statDisclosure.蘇格蘭 SIMD 2020v2（2020: Shares for Scotland's 32 council areas (S12) from SIMD 2020v2 (published January 2020 and revised in April that year for a DWP income data error; still the latest official edition as of 2026-10, there is no SIMD 2026): the share of each council area's 2011 data zones in the most deprived 10% (ranks 1–697) and 20% (ranks 1–1395) of Scotland's 6,976, denominator = total data zones in the council area. enum.statDisclosure.北愛爾蘭 NIMDM 2017（NISR: Shares for Northern Ireland's 11 local government districts (LGD2014, N09) from NIMDM 2017 (NISRA, published 2017-11-23, still the latest official edition): the share of each LGD's SOAs in the most deprived 10% (MDM ranks 1–89) and 20% (1–178) of Northern Ireland's 890 SOAs, denominator = number of SOAs in the LGD. enum.statDisclosure.疾管署法定傳染病確定病例（地區年齡性別統: Confirmed cases reported by Taiwan CDC (statistics by region, age and sex). enum.statDisclosure.文化部「文化幣可用藝文消費點」（data: Number of registrations in the Ministry of Culture's "Culture Voucher eligible arts and culture spending points" (data.gov.tw 177601, OGDL-1.0; snapshot downloaded on 2026-10-24; the source has no data-date field and its metadata date is not updated with the daily refresh) with category Performing Arts and Cultural Experiences and subcategory "Street Performers" (550 records). This is the number of registrations on the Culture Voucher merchant roster, not the number of performances or of people actually performing at a location. The source's coordinates/addresses are registration or contact addresses (mostly residential street numbers, not performance sites), so counts are made only by the administrative area of the registered address and no points are plotted. Names, telephone numbers, addresses and coordinates are not included (the product keeps only counts per administrative area). The roster is a complete national list, so an administrative area that does not appear is treated as having no registrations (0, observed), not as missing; however, registration is voluntary, and the concentration in Taichung City (223 of 550) may reflect institutional differences and must not be read as the actual distribution of street performers. Of the 550 records, 1 has a county/city field (Penghu County) that conflicts with its address/coordinates (Xizhi District, New Taipei City) and is not counted in any county/city or township (unassigned: 1), so the county/city total is 549; another record has an area field containing only the postal code 302 and is assigned to Xiangshan District, Hsinchu City according to the source coordinates.
enum.statDisclosure.衛生福利部統計處死因統計（data.go: Department of Statistics, Ministry of Health and Welfare, cause-of-death statistics (data.gov.tw 5965). The original file lists only non-zero cells: a township that is in that year's code table but has no row has 0 deaths (full registration system), not a missing value. The COVID-19 category exists only from 2020; for 2019 and earlier it is marked "not applicable". Cause-of-death codes have 41 categories for 2008-2019 and 42 from 2020 (COVID-19 added, with accidents/injuries, suicide, homicide and others shifted down); this dataset has been unified to the 42 categories used from 2020. Years up to 2007 use ICD-9 and are not included. Township of residence follows the current 368 townships (for 2008-2010, pre-reorganization areas are mapped by name). Crude death rate = deaths ÷ registered population at the end of December of the same year × 100,000; it is not age-standardized and is higher in areas with older populations. The denominator is available only from 2018, so rates are available only from 2018. Single-year values for small townships fluctuate greatly; a 5-year total is recommended. Small numbers are not masked.
enum.statDisclosure.國科會（國家災害防救科技中心）依暴露量、: The National Science and Technology Council (National Science and Technology Center for Disaster Reduction) assessed the social vulnerability of 22 counties/cities with 31 indicators across four dimensions: exposure, mitigation preparedness, response capacity and recovery capacity. Direction (NCDR briefing): the composite index and exposure are more vulnerable when higher; mitigation preparedness, response capacity and recovery capacity are better (less vulnerable) when higher.
